paragraphs: pullup is the engine behind a release and deploy panel. Point it at a project folder and it tells you what kind of project it is (an nbdev library, a plain Python package, a Rust crate and so on) and which commands release it. It then runs those commands in a terminal you can watch, and stops at the first one that fails. The same machinery runs the deploy of a web app to a virtual private server (VPS). pullup also reads the GitHub Actions workflows in the repository, writes new ones, and lists the Hetzner servers and Cloudflare tunnels the project uses.

Every public call returns plain dictionaries and lists, so a user interface can draw them and a test can compare them. The work that talks to GitHub, Docker, Hetzner and Cloudflare is done by four sibling libraries: gheasy, dockeasy, vpseasy and cfeasy.
